headline: Multi-Agency Search and Rescue Mission in Limekiln State Park, Big Sur, California
summary: MCSO Search and Rescue, Big Sur Fire and “Lasso 3” from Naval Air Station Lemoore conduct overnight rescue operation in Big Sur. Location: Limekiln State Park, Big Sur, Monterey County.
